P6-A1.title: Engine phase 6A: theta, shadows, admissibility, satake, restricted board
P6-A1.summary: theta = -w_X o tau on populations; shadow2; admissibility with each of the three conditions judged independently and Reason records as data (positions, never sentences); satake computing every field of 6.4 from rank to restricted_reflection_word_lengths and throwing NotAdmissible; restrictedBoard with orbits, simple restricted roots, the restricted Cartan matrix and the composite words w_{X u O} w_X; classifyRestricted re-exported from restrictedType.ts; golden tests for admissible_pairs, satake_examples, and the computed fields of all 167 satake records from their stored black nodes and tau; property 9.
spec: 5.5 (The longest word; Type of the restricted roots; The class of a Satake pair)
golden: satake (computed fields, from the stored black_nodes and tau of each record; the catalogue fields are P6-A2's)
deliverables: theta played in three stages (permute by tau; play the word of w_X as mutations; negate); shadow2 = alpha - theta alpha as integers

admissibility: symmetry, condition_1 (involution and tau(X) = X), condition_2 (w_X(alpha_i) = -alpha_tau(i) on X), condition_3 (<alpha_j, rho_X^vee> integer for tau-fixed white j, as a Rational), admissible; reasons as Reason records with codes and positions (and the fraction as text for not-an-integer); never sentences

satake: real rank as the span of the shadows; restricted roots and their multiplicities (asserting that multiplicity depends only on length); dim_k, dim_p, character; roots compact imaginary, real, complex; w_X_word; restricted_simple_orbits; restricted_simple_multiplicities (m_lambda, m_2lambda); restricted_cartan; restricted_board named by classifyRestricted (B_r for BC_r, A1 for r = 1); restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order; restricted_reflection_word_lengths; NotAdmissible on a failing pair; compact forms with empty lists and null types

restrictedBoard: orbits, simple restricted roots (as 2 alpha-bar), restricted Cartan matrix, composite words w_{X u O} w_X with reduced length l(w_{X u O}) - l(w_X); the board object with labels per E-7

golden tests: admissible_pairs[T] as a set for every type; satake_examples verdicts for the three conditions, admissible, and real_forms names where admissible (names through P6-A2's matchCatalogue in a later test; here the verdicts); for all 167 satake records, satake({black_nodes, tau}) reproduces every computed field; each composite word acts on shadows as the reflection of restricted_cartan
property 9: theta is an involution on populations and permutes the roots for every catalogue record
reasons.test.ts: the Reason for A3 with black node 1 and the identity carries code not-an-integer with the fraction as text; on an affine-labelled board positions are returned, not labels
acceptance: admissible_pairs, satake_examples and the computed satake fields covered and passing (G6)
E7 and E8 satake records compute within the worker budget (report the time)
traps: Condition 3 is judged independently of 2: the three lights (2.15).
tau may move black nodes and may be non-trivial with no arrow drawn (2.15 'What the diagram does not show'); store the full tau.
restricted_type is always B2 for rank 2; the C2 display adjustment is P6-A2's satakeRecord, not satake.
classifyRestricted must refuse pairs that fail condition 3 (generalized diagrams give non-root-systems); it is called only after admissibility.
The multiplicity of the restricted root is the number of roots with that shadow; a BC system has exactly one simple restricted root with a double.

P6-A5.summary: Export of diagrams for the dynkin-diagrams package with explicit marks in Bourbaki order and involutions as an option, of orbit graphs and projections as plain TikZ coordinates; the /embed/<tool> routes rendering a tool alone with the same query parameters; the Cite button's text with page title, site version, date and link.

deliverables: exportLaTeX('dynkin', {type, black, tau}) producing exactly the forms of 6.7: \dynkin[involutions={16}] E{oo***o} for e6(-14), \dynkin E{o*oo*o*} for e7(-5), \dynkin[involutions={15;24}] A{oo*oo} for su(2,4); 'tikz-graph' and 'tikz-points' as plain coordinates; the package's named diagrams are not used
embed routes for every registered tool rendering the tool alone with bare keys; a test that /embed/board?g=A2&... loads the state
Cite text: page title, site version (git commit), date, link
latex.test.ts: the three examples of 6.7 byte for byte; a Satake export for every record of Appendix B has one mark per node in Bourbaki order
acceptance: the three forms of 6.7 reproduced exactly (G6)
every embed route renders and hydrates (e2e, one per tool)
traps: Marks are one character per node in Bourbaki order; arrows are the involutions option listing white-node pairs only (6.7, 2.15).
Compiling the files is the owner's part; the build has no TeX.

P6-A2.title: Engine phase 6B: the Satake catalogue, records, canonical pairs, matching; catalogue names
P6-A2.summary: satakeCatalogue from the parametric rules of 6.4 and the exceptional entries of Appendix B; satakeRecord assembling the full record with the C2 display adjustment; canonicalPair under the board's symmetries; matchCatalogue returning all entries in the class (two on D4); the satake golden test for all 167 records, admissible_counts, and folding[*].quasi_split_real_form; scripts/names.mjs extended to typeset every catalogue name.
spec: 2.15 (which pairs are real forms; the counts; the D4 coincidence)
owns: scripts/names.mjs (extension: every real form name of 6.5, every Cartan label, every type)
deliverables: satakeCatalogue(name): the entries of 6.4 by family (A I, A II, A III/IV, B I/II, C I, C II, D I, D II, D III, compact with tau = -w_0) and the exceptional entries of Appendix B.1, each with cartan_label, real_form (plain text names of 6.5), black_nodes, tau (full, including black nodes), restricted_type_display

satakeRecord: dynkin_type, catalogue fields, arrows (white pairs), tau_moves_black_nodes, then every field of satake; the C2 adjustment: where restricted_type_display is C2, restricted_board becomes C2 and restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order is reversed
canonicalPair: least (sorted black set, then images under tau) over all symmetries g; matchCatalogue: all entries whose canonical pair equals the diagram's (0, 1 or 2)

golden tests: every satake record field by field (rule 5: matched by dynkin_type and real_form); admissible_counts for every type (classes, records, pairs total); folding quasi_split_real_form for symmetries of order 2 and null for order 3; satake_examples real_forms names; on D4 black {3,4} identity matches both so(2,6) and so*(8)
names.mjs: KaTeX markup for every real-form display name of 6.5 (with su*(2m) also shown as sl(m,H)), every Cartan label, every type name, into site/src/generated/names.json
acceptance: satake, admissible_counts, folding quasi_split_real_form covered and passing (G6)
traps: The catalogue's tau includes its action on black nodes; arrows are drawn between white nodes only (6.4, 2.15).
so(p, 2n-p) with p <= n-2 and n-p odd has the swap as tau with no arrow drawn.
sp(p,q) with p + q = n; some references write sp(2p,2q): the Atlas notes it (6.5).
The compact form's tau is -w_0: the flip on A_n (n >= 2), the swap on D_n for odd n, identity otherwise.
